usage: Use 高原 for a raised area of land that is flatter than a mountain but higher than the surrounding land.
It is a standard noun in geography, science, and school-related topics; very natural in both spoken and written Cantonese.
Common collocations include 高原地帶, 高原氣候, and 青藏高原; it often appears in place names and map descriptions.
For learners, 高原 is a neutral everyday noun: simple, concrete, and easy to use when describing landforms.
